scripts.build: npm run build -w @mcai/contracts && npm run build -w @mcai/cloud && npm run build -w @mcai/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n cloud,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @mcai/cloud" "npm run dev -w @mcai/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mcai/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mcai/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @mcai/cloud && npm run typecheck -w @mcai/web
